title: Speedy Gun Savage
description:
SGS Coming to Cyberpunk Fest But....A Note From The Team About Speedy Gun Savage

Hello Survivors,

There is a saying in games that heroes never die.

What people don't often talk about is that sometimes heroes get old. Sometimes they get tired. Sometimes they survive battles that change them forever. And sometimes they simply lay down their weapons and become part of the stories that shaped us.

Speedy Gun Savage is one of those stories.

It's hard to believe that nearly six years have passed since we first launched Speedy Gun Savage into Early Access.

When we began this journey, we had ambitious plans for the game and its future. Unfortunately, the COVID-19 pandemic brought unexpected challenges that deeply affected our team and operations especially because of VR devices and that too in India. Like many studios during that period, we lost key team members and were unable to continue development as originally planned.

As a result, Speedy Gun Savage never received the level of support, updates, and content we had envisioned.

Recently, Steam invited the game to participate in Cyberpunk Fest, which gave us an opportunity to revisit this project and make it available once again for players who may have missed it or wish to experience it for the first time.

We want to be completely transparent:

• There are currently no active development plans for Speedy Gun Savage.

• We cannot promise future updates, fixes, or new content.

• At this time, there is no committed roadmap for a full release.

That said, bringing the game back online serves another purpose. We have always wondered what players truly liked, disliked, and wanted from the experience. Even after all these years, community feedback remains incredibly valuable.

While we cannot promise a resurrection of the project, we are interested in hearing your thoughts. If enough interest exists and circumstances align in the future, those insights could help inform any discussions about revisiting the universe of Speedy Gun Savage.

Most importantly, we want to thank everyone who supported us during the game's original Early Access period. Whether you played for ten minutes or hundreds of hours, your support helped an independent studio pursue an ambitious vision during an incredibly challenging time.

Games are often remembered for their successes, but they are also built on experiments, lessons, and communities. Speedy Gun Savage remains an important part of our journey, and we're grateful that you were part of it.

Heroes don't always come back for one last mission. But sometimes they do.

Thank you for your support, your patience, and your feedback.

See you in the wasteland,

The Gamitronics Team

 

Об игреIn Speedy Gun Savage, players play as an Alien Bounty hunter, Wolf, who is sent to multiple planets for earning bounties. Wolf is supported by his robo friend, 3V4N (Evan) who helps Wolf through out the game by giving him important tips.
Speedy Gun Savage gives an almost modern day VR reimagining of good old arcade games

which has a simplicity that works nicely
Players earn a bounty (reward) for every enemy they kill and travel across multiple planets taking out as many aliens as possible by variety of guns.

Aliens are in your way to the final bosses who are your actual bounties. Wolf is supported by his robo friend, 3V4N (Evan) who helps Wolf through out the game by giving him important tips.
description_short: Speedy Gun Savage is a first person shooter VR game where Wolf, the hero of the game is an intergalactical bounty hunter and travels to different planets to collect bounties. The game has three different planets with several enemies and three main boss.
